problem.title: Minimum Operations to Reduce X to Zero

approaches.title: Direct sliding window over removed elements
approaches.summary: Tracks the remaining sum while scanning and attempts to restore a prefix when the remaining sum falls below x. This implementation is marked wrong and does not reliably enumerate valid removals.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial attempt using a sliding window that updates the sum outside the retained range and computes the number of removed elements. The implementation is marked wrong.

approaches.title: Longest retained subarray
approaches.summary: Reframes the task as finding the longest contiguous subarray whose sum is total minus x. The minimum operations are the elements outside that subarray, found with a positive-value sliding window.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced the direct removal tracking with a longest-subarray formulation using target = total - x. Handles impossible and whole-array cases, then returns the complement of the maximum valid subarray length.
